scenes.event: Toby shares his rooftop idea with colleagues during a break.
scenes.description: Toby stands near the window in the small office pantry, looking tired and slightly anxious. Rosa and Lucas approach, noticing his expression and curiosity about his whispered comment about the roof. The atmosphere is casual but tense, as Toby weighs his need for privacy against the risk of seeming distant.

actions.dialogue: I just wish I had a quiet corner of my own up on the roof. It’s the only place I can think clearly.

actions.action: Notices his expression and asks a question
actions.dialogue: You look exhausted, Toby. Is everything okay?
It’s just... the office feels so small and shared. I’m not used to it yet.
Maybe we can help you make the rooftop your own. I know a bit about design—let me hear your ideas.
I don’t know... I don’t want to seem like I’m not a team player, but I really need some space to breathe.

scenes.plot: Toby confides in Rosa and Lucas about his need for a quiet space in the office, specifically the rooftop. His colleagues respond with empathy and curiosity, helping him feel more comfortable expressing his personal needs while maintaining a sense of connection.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore how Toby can balance his values of privacy and independence with his desire to build positive workplace relationships, while also revealing his personality and background.

chunk.text: Toby, standing near the window in the pantry, lets out a sigh as he stares out at the sky. Rosa, noticing his tired expression, gently asks if he's okay. He hesitates, then shares how the shared office spaces are overwhelming for him. Lucas, intrigued, offers to help him create a private space on the roof. Toby, still anxious, considers the idea, realizing that opening up might not be as isolating as he feared.
